name: shipportx-release
description: Release tooling for ShipPortX v1.0.0: builds the website, API, Hugging Face and GitHub packages from the original dataset files and validates them.

scripts.release: npm run build:worldwide && npm run build:data && npm run build:hf && npm run validate && npm run test:api && npm run verify:api-bundle && npm run build:website && npm run check:website
